style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: juice and water containers in yellow, orange and terracotta-brown: orange juice-family keys with dark ink, a watermelon-pink Enter as the treat, soft cream keys and a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.why: Shelf of real containers (phases 1 and 4: the teacup and mug dropped on mL or L, sorted to the Less side) and the small cup beside the pan that is tipped in cup by cup for the cups count: one small opaque cup standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect.
images.prompt: A single small handleless drinking cup moulded from solid opaque sunny-yellow matte plastic, slightly tapered with a smooth plain body, a thin rounded rim and a flat base, empty and standing upright.

images.object: tall opaque saffron-orange plastic water bottle with a screw cap
images.why: Phase 1 'a teacup, a bucket and a bottle wait on the shelf' (dropped on the mL or L tag) and the shelf in phase 4 ('a bottle') sorted to More or Less the litre line: one tall opaque bottle standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect.
images.prompt: A single tall drinking-water bottle moulded from solid opaque saffron-orange plastic, with a smooth cylindrical body, a gently rounded shoulder, a narrow neck and a matching screw cap, the surface completely plain, unprinted and matte, standing upright.

images.object: bright yellow plastic household bucket, handle folded down
images.why: Phase 1 'a teacup, a bucket and a bottle' (the bucket dropped on the mL tag poured into the jug 'many times over') and phase 4 shelf 'a bucket' sorted to More: one wide opaque bucket standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect.
images.prompt: A single round household bucket of solid bright-yellow moulded plastic with a smooth tapering body, a thick rolled rim and a flat base, its black wire handle folded down flat against one side, standing upright.

images.object: brown plastic water storage tank, side view
images.why: Phase 4 shelf 'a drum' ('a bucket and a drum hold more than a litre'): one large opaque terracotta-brown plastic drum with a lid, standing upright, the big container the child must not call small because it is drawn small on the shelf; drawn in a box of its own aspect.
images.prompt: A single large round plastic water storage drum in solid terracotta-brown moulded plastic with a wide screw lid on top and a small outlet at its base, standing upright.

images.why: Phase 3 'a bowl of curd, a jug of water, a glass of buttermilk and a juice packet wait beside it' (set beside the half or quarter mark with the word about) and phase 4 shelf 'a juice packet' sorted to Less: one small opaque carton standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect.
images.prompt: A single small rectangular drink carton of solid rose-pink glossy laminated card with crisp square edges and a flat sealed fin across its top, every face completely plain, smooth and unprinted, standing upright.

images.object: clear glass water pitcher with one loop handle
images.why: The glass measuring jug at the left of the working area where the child pours: one tall clear glass jug standing upright, empty and see-through (its inside and handle opening are transparent), so the tool draws light-blue water behind it and every mark and number on top in code.
images.prompt: A plain, empty classic clear glass water pitcher with thin transparent walls, crisp dark-grey edges and a few bright highlights: a gently rounded belly narrowing slightly to the neck, a flared pouring lip with a spout on the left and one looped glass handle on the right, completely smooth and unprinted, standing upright with no reflection beneath it.

images.why: The drinking glass on the shelf of real containers beside the jug (a glass of buttermilk, the small vessels poured into the jug): one plain clear glass tumbler standing upright, empty and see-through (its inside is transparent), so the tool draws the liquid behind it in code.
images.prompt: A plain, empty, simple clear glass drinking tumbler with thin transparent walls, crisp dark-grey edges and a few bright highlights: slightly tapered with straight smooth sides, a thick clear glass base and a plain rim, no handle, completely smooth and unprinted, standing upright with no reflection beneath it.

images.object: deep orange enamel cooking pot with a lid and two small side handles
images.why: Phase 4 shelf of real containers 'a pot' (sorted to More or Less the litre line) and the pot beside the pan: one opaque cooking pot standing upright with its lid on, drawn in a box of its own aspect.
images.prompt: A single deep orange enamel cooking pot standing upright: a wide, smooth cylindrical body with a glossy solid orange enamel finish, a fitted lid with a small round knob on top and two short loop handles, one on the left side and one on the right, all in the same orange enamel, completely plain and unprinted.

images.object: light-blue and cream gable-top milk carton, upright
images.why: Phase 3 'a bowl of curd, a jug of water, a glass of buttermilk and a juice packet' and the 500 mL source: the milk carton is its own object, a real gable-top carton standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect, never the pink juice packet.
images.prompt: A single plain gable-top milk carton standing upright: a rectangular paperboard carton with a light sky-blue lower body and a warm buttery-yellow gable top, the classic pitched roof with a folded fin, smooth laminated card, every face completely plain and unprinted.
